lines.text: Many learners say: The party was a big exit.
Better: The party was a big success.
Exit is a door. Success is a win.
Success! The party was a big success.

data.wrong: The party was a big exit.
data.right: The party was a big success.
data.why: Exit is a door. Success is a win.

native.tip: En español “éxito” se parece a “exit”, pero “exit” es la salida; “éxito” es “success.”

native.comment: Respuesta: “success”. “Exit” es la puerta de salida. Para “éxito” usa “success”. Escribe una frase tuya con “success” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: “Éxito” looks like “exit”, but “exit” is a door. “Éxito” is “success.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “The party was a big exit.” Careful, false friend: “éxito” is “success”: “The party was a big success.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
